key_insight: The paper shows that symmetry constraints plus AI-guided search can make high-distance magic-state factory discovery tractable, uncovering many new low-overhead protocols.
engineering_relevance: This advances fault-tolerant quantum computing by reducing the resource cost of magic-state distillation, a major bottleneck for scalable quantum hardware.
method: Formulated triorthogonal-code and direct-circuit searches in a unified binary-matrix framework.
Used symmetry restrictions and language-model agents to prune the syndrome search space.
Completed deterministic solving and independent verification of candidate factories.
evidence_signal: The authors report 699 factory classes total, including 564 new ones, and identify pure-T factories with the lowest known overhead exponents for the stated input limits.
watch_item: The approach depends on careful symmetry selection, solver correctness, and verification, so performance may not transfer uniformly across all factory sizes or target gate sets.
paper_title: Symmetry and AI-assisted discovery of magic-state factories
